title: Malaysian-Style Paella
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this recipe combines the flavors of Malaysia with the comfort of a hearty paella. Perfect for a family dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with chicken and seafood.
Add sambal oelek, fish sauce, and palm sugar, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
